The 2016 Nissan Altima is notorious for CVT failure between 80,000 and 100,000 miles. A CVT replacement on this vehicle runs approximately $3,500 to $4,500.

I must deduct the full cost of this likely repair from the market value.
Market Value (KBB Private): $11,765
Less CVT Replacement: -$4,000
Adjusted Value: $7,765
